method: Extracted the ZIP into a different absolute directory; invoked the packaged CLI from /home/user, outside the original project CWD. Input/transcript/fonts/templates were read only from that extracted package.

renderAndFullQC.warning: Machine pass does not certify visual/semantic quality. Inspect encoded frames and moving crop/logo placement, then complete the human/agent review checklist.

negativeTests.test: moving logo late boundary crossing detected
quote end boundary excludes next sentence
screen logo unchanged across every pre-encode frame and background transition

runtimeDependencyNote: Normal installed host dependencies plus the isolated imageio-ffmpeg dependency prefix were used; executables/dependencies are explicitly not bundled.
scopeLimit: Path relocation and controlled fixture were tested, not a second actual LLM identity, unrelated footage or every host OS.
